# Slop Mop

> A browser extension that reads your feed ahead of you and folds away low-value posts ("slop"), whether a person or an AI wrote them, and shows why. Not an AI detector: a bad-writing detector. Free for one feed; live on LinkedIn.

## Start here
- [Slop Mop in brief](https://slopmop.lol/ask-ai.md): what it is, how it works, who it's for, pricing, privacy, press
- [How it works](https://slopmop.lol/how-it-works.html): the nine tells, the counter-signals, the score
- [About](https://slopmop.lol/about.html): canonical product information

## Library
- [The slop glossary](https://slopmop.lol/glossary/): an A–Z of terms for low-value content by people and by AI, each with its own page
- [The nine tells](https://slopmop.lol/patterns/): each writing pattern Slop Mop scores, with examples and fixes
- [Who it's for](https://slopmop.lol/for/): Slop Mop on each network and for each line of work
- [Compare](https://slopmop.lol/compare/): Slop Mop next to ad blockers, spam filters, AI detectors and other tools
- [Guides](https://slopmop.lol/guides/): weekly guides to cutting the slop on each network
